class.name: SentryHTTPRequest
class.brief_description: Sends HTTP requests with automatic Sentry spans, trace propagation, and breadcrumbs.

method.name: cancel_request
method.description: Cancels the current request, ends its span with an error status, and records a warning breadcrumb.

method.name: get_body_size
method.description: Returns the response body length in bytes reported by the underlying [HTTPRequest], or [code]-1[/code] when the length is unknown. Chunked responses and responses without a known content length return [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_downloaded_bytes
method.description: Returns the number of response body bytes downloaded by the underlying [HTTPRequest].

method.name: get_http_client_status
method.description: Returns the connection status of the underlying [HTTPClient].

method.name: request
method.description: Sends [param request_data] as a UTF-8 encoded request body, using [param method]. Each entry in [param custom_headers] must use the [code]Name: Value[/code] format. The SDK adds tracing headers for matching [member SentryOptions.trace_propagation_targets] unless [param custom_headers] already contains a header with the same name. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] when the request has started. This does not mean a response has arrived; connect to [signal request_completed] to receive the result. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if the node is outside the scene tree, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] if another request is in progress, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_DATA] if URL component parsing fails, or an error returned by [method HTTPRequest.request_raw]. An overlapping request leaves the existing request and its instrumentation intact. [b]Note:[/b] When this method returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CANT_CONNECT], Godot has already queued [signal request_completed]. Calling [method cancel_request] does not remove that queued signal. Wait for [signal request_completed] before starting another request.

method.name: request_raw
method.description: Sends an HTTP or HTTPS request using [param request_data_raw] as the request body without encoding conversion. Use this method for binary payloads or data that is already encoded. Uses [param url], [param custom_headers], and [param method] as described in [method request]. It provides the same tracing behavior and emits [signal request_completed] when the request finishes. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] when the request has started; other return values have the meanings described in [method request].

method.name: set_http_proxy
method.description: Sets the proxy server for HTTP requests. An empty [param host] or a [param port] of [code]-1[/code] disables the proxy. See [method HTTPRequest.set_http_proxy].

method.name: set_https_proxy
method.description: Sets the proxy server for HTTPS requests. An empty [param host] or a [param port] of [code]-1[/code] disables the proxy. See [method HTTPRequest.set_https_proxy].

method.name: set_tls_options
method.description: Configures [TLSOptions] for HTTPS connections. Create client options with [method TLSOptions.client]. See [method HTTPRequest.set_tls_options].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], Godot adds [code]Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate[/code] unless a custom [code]Accept-Encoding[/code] header is already present. Godot decompresses responses with [code]gzip[/code] or [code]deflate[/code] content encoding before delivering their bodies. If [code]false[/code], Godot neither adds the header nor decompresses the body. See [member HTTPRequest.accept_gzip]. [b]Platform support:[/b] Web browsers manage content encoding and can decompress responses independently of this property.

Maximum response body size in bytes. A value of [code]-1[/code] disables the limit. The limit also applies to the decompressed body when [member accept_gzip] is enabled. Exceeding the limit produces [constant RESULT_BODY_SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED].

Buffer size and maximum number of bytes read per network-processing iteration. Smaller values reduce buffer memory usage but can reduce download throughput. See [member HTTPRequest.download_chunk_size].

Path to a file that receives the response body. If empty, the body is kept in memory and passed to [signal request_completed]. When downloading to a file, the signal's [code]body[/code] array is empty. File-open and write failures produce [constant RESULT_DOWNLOAD_FILE_CANT_OPEN] and [constant RESULT_DOWNLOAD_FILE_WRITE_ERROR], respectively.

Maximum number of HTTP redirects to follow. A value of [code]-1[/code] disables the limit. Exceeding the limit produces [constant RESULT_REDIRECT_LIMIT_REACHED]. Redirects remain part of the same request span. [b]Warning:[/b] Godot forwards custom headers, including tracing headers, when following redirects. [member SentryOptions.trace_propagation_targets] checks only the initial URL, not redirect destinations. If a request may redirect to an untrusted destination, set this property to [code]0[/code]. The [signal request_completed] signal then reports [constant RESULT_REDIRECT_LIMIT_REACHED] and includes the [code]Location[/code] response header. Validate that URL before starting a separate request.
Request timeout in seconds, independent of [member Engine.time_scale]. A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables the timeout. An expired timeout produces [constant RESULT_TIMEOUT].
If [code]true[/code], the underlying [HTTPRequest] processes network activity on a worker thread. Request instrumentation and [signal request_completed] run on the main thread.

signal.name: request_completed
signal.description: Emitted when Godot completes the request, after its Sentry span and breadcrumb have been finalized. A handler can start another request on this node. [param result] is a value from [enum Result] describing the transfer outcome. [param response_code] is the HTTP status code, or [code]0[/code] when no response was received. [param headers] contains response headers, and [param body] contains the response bytes unless [member download_file] is set. [constant RESULT_SUCCESS] indicates that the transfer completed, not that the HTTP status is successful. Responses with a status code of [code]400[/code] or higher mark the span as an error.

constants.constant: The transfer completed. Check the HTTP response code separately to determine whether the server returned an error.
The received body length did not match the expected length.
The connection to the server could not be established.
The server's host name could not be resolved.
The connection failed while sending or receiving data.
The server did not provide an HTTP response.
Godot could not decompress the response body.
Reserved request-failure result. Unused by Godot 4.5.
Godot could not open [member download_file] for writing.
Godot could not write the response body to [member download_file].
